name: Marilith
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: The marilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Reactive Rebuke
traits.description: When a creature the marilith can see hits it with an attack roll, the marilith can make one Longsword attack against that creature as a Reaction, if it hasn't already used its Reaction this turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The marilith makes six Longsword attacks and one Tail attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 19) if it is a Large or smaller creature and the marilith doesn't have another creature Grappled.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The marilith magically teleports itself, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

description: Mariliths are serpentine, six-armed demon generals whose mastery of the blade and the battlefield makes them the Abyss's most feared tacticians, wielding six swords at once while a crushing tail seals off escape.
